# shell

The Mail app's identity (`core/app.ts`: id `mail`, `/mail`, dark only,
developer-only until it reads and sends mail), its rail entry and frame (the
sidebar-less app shell around the full-pane renderer — the threads plugin
registers the index pane and draws its own sidebar as the DataView's
`aside`), and its theme `mail` (the prototype's dark slate palette; day
groups without counts), selected in `config/ui/theme-engine/@app/mail/theme.jsonc`.

## Plugin reference

- Description: The Mail app's rail entry and frame: the standard sidebar-less app shell around the full-pane renderer (the threads list is the index pane), and the app's own dark theme from the approved prototype.
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `ThemeEngine.Theme` "Mail"
    - `Apps.App` "Mail" → `MailLayout`
  - Uses:
    - `apps-core.Apps`
    - `layouts/full-pane.FullPane`
    - `primitives/app-shell.AppShellLayout`
    - `ui/theme-engine.ThemeEngine`
- Core:
  - Uses:
    - `primitives/pane.defineApp`
    - `ui/icons.symbol`
  - Exports (values): `mailApp`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens:
    - `ui/tokens/shadow --shadow`
    - `ui/tokens/shadow --shadow-lg`
    - `ui/tokens/shadow --shadow-md`
    - `ui/tokens/shadow --shadow-sm`
  - Imported by: `apps/mail/threads`
